properties.note: Lot 7, the east 100 feet of the 1946 plat, was left out of the 1959 Replat of Fonticello Gardens No. 2 and platted into Roe-69 in 1983 (PLAT 54 7). The 1946 declaration names Lot 7 and renews every 25 years.

properties.from: Prairie Woods (1941), east 70 feet of Lot 27
properties.note: The east 70 feet of Lot 27 were resubdivided into Fonticello in 1982 (PLAT 52 24). The 1941 Restriction Agreement names Lots 1-8 and 14-31, Lot 27 among them, and renews every 25 years.
